name: stock_overview
summary: Executive landing dashboard: open transfers, on-hand pivots, valuation exposure, replenishment pressure, expiry risk, returns mix and turnover
description: Provides the top-level Inventory Overview navigation described in the enterprise blueprint as a read-only visual layer, without adding or migrating any tables. Graph and pivot dashboards are built directly on top of operational models contributed by the stock anchor and its companions: transfers by state and operation, on-hand and reserved quantities pivoted by location and product, valuation layers by source type and a value-by-product matrix, open replenishment proposals by state and trigger, stockout and reservation alerts by reason, lot expiry alerts by severity, lot release states, in-transit move backlog, return lines by disposition with a condition-versus-disposition matrix, count accuracy from inventory line differences, turnover metrics per product and the ABC/XYZ classification spread. Every panel is a view over existing records, so the dashboard never mutates operational data and stays consistent with the source of truth in each module.
author: Nexa
